pilot_source_set: s_754b5c0c (21 unique papers, merged from 3 searches)
design_diversity_achieved: biallelic case series with functional assays
case report of a novel Alu insertion

headline_observation.finding: ZERO of the eight pilot papers reported a numerical BubR1/BUB1B protein level as a percentage of control in readable text or a readable table.

dosage_measured_but_qualitative_only: PMC13349884 - 'trend toward decreased BUBR1 protein abundance', beta-actin control, PBMCs, no densitometry
PMC8769543 - 'severely reduced BUB1 protein levels', no numbers in text
dosage_numeric_but_figure_only: PMC5462940 - transcript quantification bar graph with no axis labels or values in text

headline_observation.implication: The primary exposure axis as drafted (residual protein % of control) is close to unpopulated in the human literature. This is a finding about the field, not a retrieval failure - and it is the direct test of the 'protein dosage disease' framing the user asked for before concluding. The review must either change its primary axis or report the null.

pcs_percentage.status: well populated with exact numbers AND matched control values
pcs_percentage.example: PMC13349884: Proband 1 PCS 8.93% (5/56 cells) and Proband 2 PCS 13.79% (8/58) by G-banding vs control mean 0.40 +/- 1.05%; by centromere PNA-FISH 18.58% (21/113) and 24.43% (32/131) vs control 2.95 +/- 0.60%
pcs_percentage.note: carries its own denominator (cell counts) and its own control - structurally better evidence than the protein blots

aneuploidy_percentage.example: PMC8769543: P2 lymphoblasts 35.6%, P2 primary fibroblasts 41.5% chromosome number alterations

variant_class_and_position.status: fully populated wherever a genotype is reported
variant_class_and_position.note: this is the only axis available for essentially every individual

new_individuals_found_in_pilot.significance: HIGH - architectural comparator for the proband
new_individuals_found_in_pilot.genotype: compound heterozygous c.580C>T p.Arg194Ter (nonsense, paternal) + c.2309G>A p.Arg770Gln (missense, maternal, called VUS class 3)
new_individuals_found_in_pilot.why_it_matters: p.Arg770Gln lies in the pseudokinase domain (766-1050 per Zhang 2026), paired with a nonsense allele - the SAME architecture as the proband's 737X/N1002K. Outcome: sudden unexpected postnatal collapse, 5 months intensive care, death from sepsis at 6 months.
new_individuals_found_in_pilot.caution: The authors explicitly decline to assert causality: the variant 'could play a causal or concausal role'. Must be carried as reported, not as an outcome attributable to the genotype.

new_individuals_found_in_pilot.significance: MEDIUM - monoallelic carriers of linker-region missense
new_individuals_found_in_pilot.genotype: p.A739S and p.W722R, heterozygous, in recurrent pregnancy loss
new_individuals_found_in_pilot.why_it_matters: both sit within 17 residues of the proband's stop at 737, in the same linker; phenotype is reproductive, not MVA - a dosage-gradient datapoint at the mild end

schema_fields_to_add.gene: MANDATORY NEW FIELD. PMC8769543 is BUB1, not BUB1B. Without an explicit gene field an extractor will silently merge two different diseases.
schema_fields_to_add.acmg_classification_verbatim: PMC11306263 classifies its missense as VUS class 3; PMC13349884 lists PM2+PP3. Pathogenicity assertion strength must travel with the variant.
schema_fields_to_add.author_causality_stance: PMC11306263 explicitly disclaims causality. Recording the authors' own confidence prevents the review from asserting more than the sources do.
schema_fields_to_add.prenatal_findings_verbatim: raised maternal serum AFP, fetal microcephaly, pericardial effusion, ascites - present in 2 of 8 pilot papers, and relevant to early ascertainment
schema_fields_to_add.non_tumour_organ_complications: PMC7455400 reports chronic glomerulosclerosis, renal failure at 15, transplant at 20, chylothorax. A tumour-only outcome field discards the majority of this patient's disease burden.
schema_fields_to_add.reproductive_phenotype: recurrent pregnancy loss and products-of-conception aneuploidy (PMC13349884) - a distinct phenotype axis at the mild end of the dosage gradient
schema_fields_to_add.cause_of_death_verbatim: PMC11306263 death from sepsis, not tumour - conflating any death with disease progression would be wrong
schema_fields_to_add.assay_method_for_pcs: G-banding vs centromere PNA-FISH give materially different PCS rates in the SAME individuals (8.93% vs 18.58%). Method must be recorded or the numbers are not comparable.
schema_fields_to_add.control_value_and_spread: PCS and aneuploidy percentages are only interpretable against the same paper's control mean and SD

ambiguities_requiring_extractor_rules: PMC7455400 gives the same variant as c.2386-11A>G in text and figure legend but c.2387-11A>G in the discussion. Rule needed: record verbatim, flag internal inconsistency, do not silently pick one.

Reviews restate primary cases without genotype detail (PMC8125975 gives 'biallelic deleterious or loss-of-function mutations' with no HGVS). Rule needed: reviews are seeds, never extraction sources - already in protocol eligibility.
Figure-legend and body text disagree on the same percentage within one paper (PMC10602889: 15% vs 10% prophase DNA damage). Rule needed: record both, flag, prefer body text, never average.
Where a paper reports 'trend toward decreased' with no number, the correct extraction is a qualitative_direction field plus residual_protein_pct = null, NOT an estimated number.

hybrid: domain location - mapped to the Zhang 2026 map where residue number allows, else 'not_determinable'

pilot_verdict: The collection schema is sound but its PRIMARY AXIS must change. Recommend demoting residual_protein_pct from primary exposure to a sparse secondary field, and promoting a composite exposure of (variant class + domain position) with PCS%/aneuploidy% as the best-populated quantitative severity readout. This is a material change and requires user approval before Evidence proceeds.
